item.title: Mitigate now: F5 BIG-IP APM: Heap-based Buffer Overflow
item.description:
F5 BIG-IP APM: Memory corruption (possible RCE) · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · partial fix

First step: Only engineering hotfixes exist, through F5 support. Ask for the hotfix or apply the vendor's mitigation, and restrict who can reach F5 BIG-IP APM until a regular release is out.

F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

Critical · Partial fix · CVE-2026-94127
